firm_data.firm_description: Wenig Saltiel LLP is led by Meryl L. Wenig and Jeffrey L. Saltiel, and comprised of an experienced team of dedicated, innovative and passionate attorneys. The firm is committed to promoting their client's objective and delivering results and are adept at handling complex litigation issues.
notable_facts: Meryl L. Wenig has over 25 years of experience in Landlord/Tenant Law and is recognized as a tough, no-nonsense litigator.
Jeffrey L. Saltiel has been called upon to serve various courts as a Guardian Ad Litem and has represented numerous Receivers and other court appointed fiduciaries.

email.subject: AI for Wenig Saltiel LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jeffrey,

Meryl's 25+ years in Landlord Tenant Law and her reputation as a tough litigator tell me Wenig Saltiel handles some of the most demanding real estate litigation cases in NYC. That requires precision, speed, and zero room for error.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into NYC. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on complex litigation.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
